topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Got a neighbor wants to put up a fence, huh? Figures. People start building walls when they think the space around them isn't safe enough, or when they reckon the people next door are more trouble than they’re worth. I heard him knocking on doors, mustering up signatures for some kind of community board. Not that I’m surprised. This city’s a place where privacy’s a luxury you can’t afford not to have, but neighborly trust’s a currency that’s been depreciating for a while now. I reckon I’ll talk to him, maybe find out what made him decide the boundary lines needed some adjusting. Could be nothing, or maybe there’s a story here that’s just waiting to be peeled back.
